goal_model.family: Dynamic multi-league hierarchical Poisson MAP + Dixon-Coles
goal_model.implementation_note: MAP/time-decay approximation; not a full MCMC state-space posterior.

method.event_models: recency-weighted negative-binomial count models with venue/opponent blending and shrinkage
method.ticket_filter: one leg per match; same bookmaker; odds 1.90-2.10; model/market gap <=12pp; minimum eight observations
method.important: Event models are not historically calibrated and do not guarantee future returns.
